takeaways.text: Data Center revenue hit a record $26.3B, up 154% — about $87 of every $100 Nvidia took in — as cloud builders raced to train and run AI models on Hopper chips.
takeaways.title: Data Center is the company now

takeaways.text: Net income reached $16.6B — 55 cents of every revenue dollar — because the 75.1% gross margin held while revenue more than doubled.
takeaways.title: More than half of sales became profit

takeaways.text: Nvidia guided third-quarter revenue to $32.5B as Blackwell samples shipped to partners and customers, with the new chips set to ramp in the following quarter.
takeaways.title: Guidance pointed higher

verdict: Nvidia's revenue more than doubled to a record $30.0B as Data Center sales jumped 154% on Hopper AI chips — and it kept $16.6B as profit, about 55 cents of every dollar.
